title: Coral Ave - Coral Cove
meta_description: Coral Cove: PCB escape with private pool, fireplace, and patio w/ BBQ, just minutes to the beach, dining, and top attractions along the Emerald Coast.
description_expanded:
Welcome to Coral Cove, your laid-back Panama City Beach escape with a private pool, bright coastal interiors, and easy access to the sugar-white sands of the Emerald Coast. Tucked away on Coral Ave, this 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom home offers the perfect blend of comfort, style, and outdoor fun---just minutes from the beach, dining, and local attractions.

Inside, Coral Cove feels fresh, airy, and welcoming. The open-concept living area is designed for easy gathering, with comfortable seating, a TV, and a sleek fireplace that adds a cozy touch after a day in the sun. The adjacent kitchen is equally inviting, featuring clean finishes, generous counter space, and bar seating that makes everything from quick breakfasts to evening snacks effortless. A washer and dryer add extra convenience for longer stays and beach-filled days.

The home comfortably sleeps eight guests across two thoughtfully designed bedrooms, plus a queen sleeper sofa in the living room for additional flexibility. The primary bedroom features a king bed, TV, and private ensuite bathroom for a restful retreat. The second bedroom is a fun and functional setup for families or groups, offering a queen-over-king bunk bed, TV, and its own ensuite bathroom.

Step outside to your private backyard oasis. The sparkling pool is surrounded by loungers and plenty of room to unwind, while the spacious patio offers a dining table for meals outdoors and a BBQ grill for easy cookouts. There's even a game of Connect Four for a little extra fun between swims. Whether you're enjoying a sunny afternoon by the water or winding down in the evening, the backyard is made for vacation living.

Located close to the beach, Coral Cove makes it easy to enjoy the best of Panama City Beach---from relaxing on the shoreline to exploring nearby restaurants, shops, and attractions. Whether you're planning a family getaway, a couples trip, or a small group escape, Coral Cove is a stylish and easygoing home base for your time on the coast.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Hub 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Laguna Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- This home allows up to 2 pets for a fee; undisclosed pets brought without AvantStay's approval may result in a $500 fine per pet.
- The property has turf throughout the yard. Guests should not park on the turf and try to keep foot traffic off of it as much as possible.
- There is a space in front of the home lined with rock where the guests can park an additional car, as well as 2 (one behind the other) in the driveway.
- Pool heat is available for an additional $150/day and must be requested 24-48 hours before the day of check-in.

Parking Details:
- Parking is available in the driveway for 3 cars.

This home comes with a pack n' play travel crib available.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
